description: A component in page content that sits at the same place on two pages under a shared layout disconnects when its page is left and a new instance connects on every SPA visit, so each page's input is bound once with that page's settings while the layout element is kept

browserSteps.value: Initial load: the main watcher connects once and binds the main input
window.__spaMarker = 'kept'; document.querySelector('.layout-nav').__layoutMarker = 'kept';

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const expected = JSON.stringify({connected: {main: 1}, disconnected: {}}); const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const record = window.__filterWatcher; const actual = JSON.stringify(record && {connected: record.connected, disconnected: record.disconnected}); if (actual === expected) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('lifecycle counts: expected ' + expected + ', got ' + actual)); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
first

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const expected = JSON.stringify({changes: {main: 1}, lastChange: 'main:first'}); const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const record = window.__filterWatcher; const actual = JSON.stringify(record && {changes: record.changes, lastChange: record.lastChange}); if (actual === expected) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('change handling: expected ' + expected + ', got ' + actual)); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
SPA navigation to the other page: the main watcher disconnects and a new watcher binds the other input

if (window.__spaMarker !== 'kept') { throw new Error('the page reloaded instead of navigating in place'); } if (document.querySelector('.layout-nav').__layoutMarker !== 'kept') { throw new Error('the shared layout element was replaced'); }
